question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? 

43, 45, 48, 53, 60, 71, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive prime numbers are added subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/715285a83aafd3fe5ac7faab5a4de8756544e7fab96be6c1ec3bd0ce84c898f0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d59e4fe19de7e803bb79a8b694e9795b884757ed725454ae52a0dd0fc87629d.png] 

Hence, "**84"** is the correct answer.
